title: Kid Klutch shares a new single "Double Ended Rifle"
htmlContent:
Canadian-based artist Kid Klutch has releases a new single called "Double Ended Rifle," a track off upcoming EP titled "Level Up." The talented artist "Kid Klutch" is set to take over the music industry with his upcoming EP. "Double Ended Rifle" is another incredible release for this rising talent and gives us all a reason to be excited for his project dropping on September. Its a sure fire experience of music full of replay value to keep us coming back for more and to put the culture on notice of this stand out talent.

Kid Klutch continues to drop fire releases with this latest release “Double Ended Rifle” being some of his hottest work to date. His signature flow is on full display as it pushes the song forward righteously, while having so much life to it that you are able to not only marvel at his pen but also feel his undeniable presence on this record that doesn’t miss. For more follow Kid Klutch on Instagram.
